**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 18:42
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK watches from Nezha's chariot as the fight turns, the celestial army begins to win and the monkeys start to run.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK frantically looks for Macaque and Wukong but can't see them in the chaos.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha, who's piloting the chariot, notices MK's distress and tries to reassure him, saying, "Don't worry, mortal. We'll find them."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK expresses his worry, saying, "I hope they're okay," with a shaking voice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A figure dashes out from the trees, covered in cuts and bruises; it is Macaque.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque jumps up and grabs onto the chariot as it passes by, and Nezha calls down, "Get in!"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque clambers into the chariot and collapses onto the floor, panting heavily, saying, "Wukong got away, but I have his necklace."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK looks down at Macaque's hand and sees the glittering necklace, exclaiming, "That's the diamond snare."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Macaque confirms, "Yes, and it's the only thing that can hold Wukong. We have to keep it safe."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha agrees, stating, "We will take it to the Jade Emperor. He will know what to do with it."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK looks at the necklace, wondering what will happen next.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha lands his chariot next to MK and asks, "Are you alright, mortal?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK responds, "I think so. That was... unbelievable. Thank you for saving me."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha reassures MK, saying, "It is our duty to protect the innocent from harm. I am glad I was able to do so."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK looks around at the aftermath of the battle and asks, "What will happen to the monkeys now?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nezha sighs and explains, "They will be brought to the Jade Emperor for judgment. It is up to him to decide their fate."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MK expresses guilt, saying, "I didn't mean for any of this to happen. I just wanted to find a story to tell."
